title: Equiangular

inlines.v: EQUIAN'GULAR, adjective [Latin oequus, equal, and angulus, an angle.] In geometry, consisting of or having equal angles; an epithet given to figures whose angles are all equal, such as a square, an equilateral triangle, a parallelogram, etc.
